answer: Presence is the toll: each identity plants a lotus, 25 POA bonded to one key, wilting on failure. Each epoch names a zenith hour; a beacon reveals the exact minute only then, and each key signs that nonce in 90 seconds. Twelve lottery-drawn wander auditors replay all answers, flagging misses or shared signatures. Fail and the lotus wilts: 25 POA burned, the key benched one epoch. Limit: scripts farm presence; this prices uptime, not whales. One minute demands N watches: N fakes × 25 POA = 25N POA forfeited.
